title: Austin Budget, New Sidewalks, Tax Error Fixed
summary:
*   **Annual City Budget Approved:** The 1920 city budget was officially adopted.
*   **Major Infrastructure Plans:** A special meeting was called to authorize new sidewalks and curbs on numerous streets, along with paving an alley.
*   **Property Tax Correction:** The city council approved correcting a 1919 property tax valuation error for a specific estate.
*   **Private Curbing Initiative:** A local business received permission to install curbing at its location, under city supervision.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, February 5th, 1920;
The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present : Mayor Yett, Councilman Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward; absent, none.
The minutes of the last meetings were read and upon motion of Councilman Haynes were
adopted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Council- man Alford, Graham, Haynes and
Ward, 5; nays none.
Councilman Haynes move that the regular order of business be suspended and Mr. A.O. Watson
be heard.
A.O. Watson appeared before the Council in connection with the curbing at the S.W. Corner
of West 6th and Lavaca Streets.
Councilman Ward moved that the matter be referred to Councilman Graham with full power to
act in the premises.
Motion was adopted by the following vote Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward.
W.L. Ayres appeared and asked permission to put in curbing at his place of business
situated at the corner of West 6th and Lavaca Streets.
Permission was granted provided the work be done under the supervision of the City
Engineer.
Motion carried by the following vote, Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward.
The Monthly Reports of the following named were read and ordered filed Fred Sterzing
Assessor and Collector; A.B. Anderson Public Weigher; Miss Dorsey Spiller Municipal Nurse,
and Mrs. R.C. Walker Pure Food Inspector.
Councilman Haynes introduced the following Resolution:

RESOLUTION.
Whereas. The Board of Equalization through error raised the valuation of improvements on
the West two-thirds of lot 6, in Block 87 from $900 to $1500.00 for taxes of 1919, as per
the statement of Mr. James Belger President of the Board herewith attached. Therefore be
it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin that the Assessor and Collector be
and he is hereby authorized to correct said assessment making same $900 and to take credit
for amount of reduction. H.L Haynes, Supt.


 --- Page break --- 

304

Austin, 2/4/20.
Hon. H.L. Haynes, Comm. Finance and Accounts.
In the matter of assessment of Mrs. Marie Gross Estate, the Board of equalization
erronously increased the value of Improvements on the W 2/3 of lot 6 in Block 87 from $900
to $1500. We lost sight of the age of said Improvements and failed then to conform to
Improvement of recent construction on lot in the immediate neighborhood.
James Belger, Pres. Board.
The above Resolution was adopted by the following vote, Mayor Yett, Councilman Alford,
Graham, Haynes and Ward.
The Mayor submitted the budget of 1920 to the Council for their approval.
Councilman Haynes moved that the Budget be approved which was accordingly done by the
following vote, Mayor Yett, Councilmen
Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward.
The communication of Robinson Brothers, compressed between fourth and fifth streets on
East Avenue.
Councilman Alford moved that communication be referred to C.L.
Woodward, Chief of the Fire Department, and J.E. Woody Fire Marshall for their report back
to the City Council.
Motion carried by the following vote, Mayor Yett, Councilman
Graham, Alford, Haynes and Ward.

CALLED MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, February 6th, 1920/
The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present. Mayor Yett, Councilman Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward.
Austin, Texas, February 6, 1920.
To the Honorable Members of the City Council.
City of Austin, Texas.
Gentlemen:
I do hereby call a special meeting of the City Council to be convened in the Council
Chamber at eleven o'clock A.M. Feby. 6th, 1920, for the purpose of considering resolutions
with reference to ordering in sidewalks and curbs on the following streets, vis: Rio
Grande Street between Sixth and Twenty-Seventh Streets.
North Congress Ave.- Fourteenth to Nineteenth.
Guadalupe Street - 19th to 27th Street.
Twenty-first Street-Speedway and Guadalupe Street.
Wichita Street-19th to 21st Street.
Speedway-19 to 21st Street.
West Sixth Street-Blanco to Crockett Street Sixteenth Street-Guadalupe to Sabine Street.
Also for the ordering the paving of the alley between 4th and fifth Streets from Colorado
to Lavaca Streets. Yours truly,
W.D. Yett. Mayor.
